_: PRODUCTION HANDS (11-14). Which machines may CHANGE live systems (Railway, Cloudflare, Google/Bing submissions, posting). Missing / broken / not listed = NO hands (fail closed): the machine observes and recommends only. Moves back toward safety (reverting its own lever, raising a cap after a crash) are always allowed. Changing a value here is a Kai decision.

cost.why: 11-14: was about to set a hard 1.1 GB memory limit on live web at the 03:17 run to save cents; a traffic wave would OOM-kill the app. Scaling > pennies. Recommends only until rebuilt with load headroom rules.

shield.why: security layer: bans repeat attackers 7 d at Cloudflare. 11-14: never bans shared networks or search/AI crawlers (shield-lib, tested). Broken hands file = no new bans; expired bans always lifted.

bing-send.why: ai-machine: daily Bing URL quota, steered by works tiers. Free, reversible; wrong pages only waste quota.

bing-submit.why: weekly Bing URL batch + feed. Free.

indexnow.why: tells Bing/Yandex about URLs whose lastmod moved. Free.

gsc-sitemap.why: re-submits the sitemap to Google daily. Read-mostly; the sitemap itself is site code.

reels.why: posts reels to crtlab.pro IG + FB only (account lock in post.mjs). The one channel that has shown a breakout (FB 5,930 plays 11-14).
